question: Should the official memory-lancedb plugin grow built-in BM25 plus vector hybrid retrieval now, or should advanced LanceDB hybrid and rerank behavior stay external or ClawHub-owned?
rationale: The feature is source-verifiably missing and feasible inside the plugin, but it changes retrieval semantics, config/defaults, persistent index lifecycle, and fallback policy for an official memory backend.

options.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
options.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned hybrid mode with FTS indexing, explicit config/defaults, vector fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests.

options.title: Keep advanced retrieval external
options.body: Leave official memory-lancedb vector-only and point advanced LanceDB hybrid/rerank behavior to an external package or ClawHub path.

options.title: Document vector-only by design
options.body: Close the direction after documenting that memory-lancedb is a vector backend while memory-core and QMD own hybrid retrieval.

recommendation.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
recommendation.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned hybrid mode with FTS indexing, explicit config/defaults, vector fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests.
